plugins.name: protect-main-branch
plugins.description: Prevent git operations that would modify the main branch (or configured branches) in Claude Code

plugins.name: session-handover
plugins.description: Session handover and takeover skills for managing task continuity between Claude Code sessions

plugins.name: retrospective
plugins.description: Retrospective skill based on a 6-stage process (input → interpretation → planning → action → inspection → output) to surface problems and apply improvements

plugins.name: session-tts
plugins.description: Read Claude Code-related audio cues locally with a different Japanese voice per session. The Stop hook injects a reminder asking Claude to summarize each turn in one short phrase via mid-turn say; permission prompts are narrated with the workspace name. Multiple hook reminders (TodoWrite/Monitor/Agent/UserPromptSubmit) nudge progress narration at milestones. ON by default; engine and models managed automatically. Apple Silicon only.
